title: Tenma Saki — Excitement Explosion〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there they are!
Hey, you guys!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew. Thanks for waiting!
I thought I left pretty early, but I somehow ended up the last one here...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It wasn't by much, though. We also just got here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, you're still pretty early.
I guess we all are, now that I think about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to think we've all been wondering what we're gonna talk about today! I couldn't sit still because I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been like that all morning as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're not supposed to meet with Mr. Shindo for a little while, but... I guess we should start making our way over so we don't end up running late.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're supposed to talk about what we need to do before we can make our debut today, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our debut...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope we get to talk about our new song soon. I want us to hit the scene by making a huge splash! How awesome would that be?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A huge splash?
We're not really that kind of band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm saying that we should strive to become the talk of the town!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In any case, I'm really excited.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you guys also need to come up with autographs for yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've got a super cute design for mine♪
I think it's my best work yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, I think you're getting ahead of yourself. We sorta have more important things to figure out first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, this is important!
Who knows when we might end up needing them?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you have time to think about that kind of stuff, then you should be practicing instead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... Y-Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, you used to take calligraphy lessons. I have a feeling your autograph is going to look really cool...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
If anything, Honami and I might be the only ones having trouble.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I can show you some tricks to make your autographs look super cool! I've already done a ton of research♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, practice takes priority.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, just gimme a second to explain!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All you have to do is make some sort of reference to your names. For example, Ichi, yours could include some stars, and yours could include a moon, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If you make them really small and add them as an accent, then they'll look really cute!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, your advice is more specific than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, does this mean you'd already come up with autographs for us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, they came to me while I was thinking up my own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we can refer to those when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. But to be fair, that's probably not going to be for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait until then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, we need to start heading over to the office.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Time really does fly when you're having a fun conversation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
But I'm starting to feel nervous all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the discussion we're about to have is about our future as a band! We need to make it a good one...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, everyone, let's go...!
Off to Solis Records!
